integrity: The complete 103-tetrahedron complex is embedded. Integral first homology is reconstructed by unimodular Smith reduction, exact free and torsion coordinates are independently certified by cocycles, and every three-vertex clique is exhaustively checked.
scientific_limitations: The finding concerns simple edge cycles in one fixed labelled seventeen-vertex triangulation. The displayed free basis is computational rather than canonical, and the theorem does not compare geometric Nil metrics or alternate triangulations.
title: The triangular homology shell of the seventeen-vertex Nil manifold \(M_2\)
